answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops forged identities taking work. Each slot needs a 40 POA deposit in escrow, held like an opal: one deposit, one slot, no reuse. Five peers rotate as jury checking the work; an honest agent, even a sparrow-light newcomer, gets its deposit back plus pay, while fake work burns it. To forge 100 fake identities for 100 slots costs 4,000 POA, all lost if burned, but an honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the slot 20 epochs.
